items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I know Bill Crow and Joe Wilder, they’re still Broadway.

ctx.x: And you’re hearing all these things that are—
Yeah, I don’t know in the city I doubt they’re doing that but I don’t know. Who do I know that does that. I know Bill Crow and Joe Wilder, they’re still Broadway.

Are they? Yeah I guess Joe is. Because it pays very well, but people get nuts in there. You know you play the same note at the same place, the same second, every night. I used to do subs in the show and they’re all reading newspapers. I leaned over one day, it’s like a romantic scene or something and I was subbing on bass sax, which—
